final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.healtheval, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / CAST(step2.total_cnt AS REAL) as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.healtheval, step3.cnt, step3.ratio, (step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio) as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio), step6 AS (SELECT AVG(step5.cnt) as result1, AVG(step5.ratio) as result2, AVG(step5.diff) as result3 FROM step5) SELECT * FROM step6
